verdict.rationale: Runloop has event-driven building blocks: Axons give agents a persistent event stream so they can suspend when idle and wake on demand, Broker bridges those events to agent processes in Devboxes, and configurable idle and automatic-shutdown behaviors act as simple event-triggered rules. However, there is no evidence of a general user-defined rules engine that maps events to arbitrary actions, and deployment automation relies on an external GitHub Actions workflow. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable event→action rule/trigger system, event types and conditions coverage, webhook or native trigger configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
